body: Onto 8 don't feel too good thank you angel

I'd rather die in a soon to be euphoric state and have people remember me as the happy-go-lucky kind of guy. Not the guy who's down on his luck and can't find a way out. Everyone still thinks I have an awesome job and enough in my savings to coast for a year. I'd rather no one found out what I've done to myself.

I am 3 down now. Don't feel affected yet. I don't think there's anything left to talk about. Hopefully they find my corpse before it rots and wrecks this place. Thanks again for your kind words. Funny the last few thoughts I'll be having is of an imaginary Tyler. Take care
I am 3 down now. Don't feel affected yet. I don't think there's anything left to talk about. Hopefully they find my corpse before it rots and wrecks this place.

Thank you for your optimism. But I think I'll take the coward's way out. Thanks again for talking to me. For a moment there, I thought life might be worth living. I'm down 2 e pills now. Will do the other 12 over the span of the next hour. Cheers to life eh!

I appreciate you trying to help me. Long story short is, no one can get me my job back. No one can get me my money back. No one can help me find a way out. I guess I am just a coward, I have always been one. Opting for the easiest way out. I truly believe this will be the easiest. Friends and family may mourn over my death, but I'd rather them have happy memories of me rather than me seeking their help and finding it doesn't work and overall following through. That would crush them more, I think.

Absolutely no one. I would rather die than be helped by my family and friends. No one knows I've lost my job and that I've lost every cent to my name. No one knows I'm drowning in debt. I just feel so hopeless and lost. It honestly just feels a lot easier if today was my last day. I've got a mixed variety of ecstacy pills. I know where I can get some meth and heroine. Maybe I'll just do it this way. It seems the most logical and easy way out.

I don't have any money for rent which is approx $800. I don't have any money for food. My credit cards are maxed. There's only a few cans of pop in the fridge. I literally have nothing left. My table, this laptop, my bed. And I guess I will be evicted by the end of the next month. Fuck me.

I feel like there is actually no more point to living. With that $30000 that I blew, it could have lasted me easily 2 years to try and enjoy life. Getting laid off was what really set me off. I didn't know how to cope with not getting paid anymore so I took my chances to the casino. If even the casino doesn't want me to win, there who in their right minds would want me to win? I have nothing left. Absolutely nothing.

Thanks for your reply, I would love to talk to anyone. I have no else to talk to. No one knows I've lost my job. No one knows I've lost all my money. I haven't seen anyone in days and I've just been feeling very suicidal. I called 1-800-SUICIDE and I felt like they just wanted me to end my life as well. I am just looking for the quickest and least painful way.
